theme_strategy: Light Theme Priority (Clean, focused learning environment with premium hospitality aesthetics)
emotional_archetype: Organic & Earthy + Old Money Tech (Sophisticated, calm, professional, focused on real-world hospitality)

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' Pairing (Classic Serif Head + Sterile Clean Body) to evoke a premium boutique hotel or high-end restaurant menu.

hierarchy_rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif text-brand-espresso tracking-tight
hierarchy_rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif text-brand-espresso tracking-tight
hierarchy_rules.labels: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-sans font-semibold text-brand-charcoal/60

background.description: Warm sand/oat for the main background to reduce eye strain, pure white for cards to create clean contrast.

text.description: Never use pure black. Use charcoal or deep espresso to maintain the earthy, organic feel.

accents.description: Deep Forest Green (#1C3329) for primary buttons and success states (calm, growth). Terracotta (#C86F53) for highlights, alerts, or 'No lo sabía' actions.

radii.note: Subtle roundness to keep it modern but not childish. Avoid fully pill-shaped cards; keep them rectangular with soft corners.

textures.noise: Subtle grain texture overlay on the hero background to remove digital flatness and add a printed editorial feel.

layouts_and_grids.spacing_philosophy: Generous Spacing (Tailwind p-6, p-8, p-12). Interface must feel like a premium printed magazine, not a cramped web app.
layouts_and_grids.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid Protocol. High density but organized. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6.
layouts_and_grids.lesson_view: Max-w-2xl mx-auto (Narrow container for reading comfort). Generous vertical padding (py-12 or py-16).

cards.style: Neumorphism Tactile Variant. bg-white, 1px border-subtle, very soft shadow. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow deepens.
cards.usage: Dashboard widgets, category selection, lesson flashcards.

buttons.primary: bg-[#1C3329] text-white hover:bg-[#13231C] transition-all duration-200 rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-sans font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-[#1C3329] border border-[#1C3329]/20 hover:bg-[#F9F8F6] transition-all duration-200 rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-sans font-medium

navigation.style: Glassmorphism (Crystal Variant) for sticky top nav if content scrolls under. backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F8F6]/80 border-b border-black/5.

progress_bar.style: Extremely thin (h-1 or h-2), track: bg-black/5, indicator: bg-[#1C3329]. Minimalist and unobtrusive.

flashcard.style: Aspect-video or square, front and back states. Requires framer-motion for a realistic 3D flip effect (rotateY). Clean typography centered.

motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade in and slight slide up (framer-motion opacity: 0 to 1, y: 10 to 0).
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must have a clear hover state (color darken or slight transform).
motion_and_interactions.flashcard_flip: Smooth spring physics for the flip animation to make it feel tactile.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Ensure focus rings (ring-2 ring-[#1C3329] ring-offset-2) are visible for keyboard navigation.

hero_background.description: Elegant boutique hotel interior, use with a subtle overlay (e.g., bg-[#F9F8F6]/80 or a gradient) so text is highly readable.

category_coffee.description: Barista pouring coffee, for the 'Coffee Shop Staff' category.

category_restaurant.description: Confident modern waiter, for the 'Waiters / Restaurant' category.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize Mobile-First design. All layouts must look exceptional on mobile screens (max-h-[80vh] for images, touch-friendly tap targets).

Use raw HTML/Tailwind for the Marketing Landing Page to achieve editorial asymmetry. Use Shadcn components for the Dashboard and Lesson elements (Forms, Cards, Progress). Note: The project uses .js/.jsx files, not .tsx. Adjust your component syntax accordingly (remove TypeScript types).
DO NOT use a childish Duolingo style. The app must feel like a premium tool for professionals.
Implement the lesson flow as a multi-step component (or separate routes) with a seamless transition between Intro -> Dialogue -> Flashcards -> Exercises -> Quiz -> Completion.
Flashcards MUST use framer-motion for the flip effect. Include 'Lo sabía' (Green action) and 'No lo sabía' (Terracotta action) buttons.
Ensure the UI language is entirely in Spanish, while the learning content (phrases, dialogues) is in English/Spanish as required.
Always apply a `data-testid` attribute to all interactive elements for testing purposes.
Include `lucide-react` for minimalist icons (e.g., Coffee, Utensils, Bed, CheckCircle).
Do not use generic 'Inter' for headings. Stick to 'Playfair Display' for Headings and 'Manrope' for body text to maintain the premium feel.
Ensure contrast ratios meet APCA/WCAG standards, especially for text over images.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and delicate shadows.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters where appropriate (e.g., sticky headers).
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., `transition: all`). Target specific properties.
DO NOT center align the app container in CSS. Left-align dense content for reading flow.
Use modern button styles (rounded-lg) with clear interaction animations and brand-relevant colors.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters for icons. Use proper SVG libraries.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, focus states, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Use the provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text for images.
